The run separates 13 accepted responses from one actually executed model action and proves four zero-model-action games exactly match verified-local. The fixed seed-410 Rule win is restored in both baseline and round01 at 18 turns/84 steps. A useful next certificate must bind an already-public partner damage breakpoint and preserve any productive Rule prefix, rather than merely increase model takeover or route freedom.

The formal run therefore remained 2/5 versus 2/5 and seed 409 lengthened from the Rule floor's 96 steps to 109 without a winner flip.

The formal artifact proves the certificate never owned an action and that seed 409 diverged earlier, while all three zero-model-action games remained exactly equal to verified local.

The exact same-turn line still supplies a deterministic +30 damage with no reactive, random, survival, hidden-information, or Active-damage-interaction hazard, so it may be evaluated as a damage-dominance prefix but must never be mislabeled as an immediate prize breakpoint.
